Default invocation returns prepared-only before state creation. Explicit run requires real owner TTY, fresh canonical owned private directory outside checkout, own fresh PostgreSQL and existing canonical migrations without seed or fixture grants.

Read-only status/recovery and standard onboarding/password routes remain admitted; chat/model/booking/clients/records and provider writes are not admitted.

Seven finite native GET path templates at exact HTTPS api.yclients.com, selected company binding, only companies?my=1 query, redirect:error, 64 request/256 session dispatch caps, 120-second request/20-second fetch bounds, 2MiB response cap. Guard installed before AppModule import; ready asserts zero startup provider calls.

Shared web relay fenced before handlers for exact Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch; direct backend fenced again. Self-only CSP, no-referrer and no-store enforced. Relay timeout125s exceeds finite source request120s.

Preparation15m, hidden prompt120s, startup60s, runtime<=15m, owned TERM/KILL cleanup and exact PG directory stop. Only bounded route-kind IPC counters accepted and required at clean ready-session stop; no provider URLs, IDs, body or token in this summary.

All six new source files match the committed Git bytes and are included in future launcher source binding. Existing A17 authority, migrations, runtime owners, stage0 source and frontend are unchanged by this six-file commit.

Native adapter evidence uses five synthetic fetch responses through the real adapter; no actual provider data, credentials or model requests.
This is application-layer routing/dispatch control, not an OS packet-level egress firewall or cross-UID secret isolation claim.

Partner remains in child environment/in-memory JavaScript strings for the session; no claim of cryptographic memory erasure or invisibility to same-user process inspection. User token and imported configuration/team data use existing encrypted/private local DB retention.
